derived_from.info_title: VCF Operations for networks API Reference

authentication.scheme_note: Derived from the description of operationId 'create' (POST /auth/token) in the source specification.
authentication.spec_quote: All API requests must provide the auth token in Authorization header in following format: Authorization : NetworkInsight {token}. If a token is invalid or expired, 401-Unauthorized error gets returned in the response of the API request. There is limit of 100 valid tokens per user and further requests will return 401-Unauthorized. So, users are advised to delete the tokens after use

domain_type.note: Spec: domain type, should be in uppercase

value.note: Spec: domain value, not required for LOCAL domain. Omit the key entirely when unset.

query_parameters.name: cursor
query_parameters.description: Cursor from previous response. Omit the parameter entirely on the first page.

query_parameters.name: modifiedAfter
query_parameters.description: Timestamp after which apps have been modified. Unused by this task; omit entirely.

properties.results: array of EntityId { entity_id, entity_type, entity_name }
properties.cursor: string, absent or null on the final page

path_parameters.name: id
path_parameters.description: The Entity ID of object requesting information on

query_parameters.name: fetch_member_counts
query_parameters.description: True, if member counts should be fetched.

query_parameters.name: fetch_update_status
query_parameters.description: True, if the update status of the saved application should be fetched. Unused by this task; omit entirely.

401.note: Spec: deleting an expired or invalid token results in 401.

wire_rules.omit_unset_optionals: An optional query parameter or optional JSON body field that has no value MUST be omitted from the request entirely. Sending the key with an empty string, an empty JSON object, or null is a contract violation.
wire_rules.no_extra_fields: Requests MUST NOT carry query parameters or JSON body fields outside those listed for the operation.
wire_rules.authorization_header: Exactly one space between the 'NetworkInsight' scheme token and the token value.
wire_rules.content_type: Requests with a JSON body MUST send Content-Type: application/json.
